comments.text:
Hey, Cory. I know that you might not actually see this comment, and I’m just one dude and you’re like—one of the most popular men on YouTube, along with having so many things on your plate. 

But I just want to thank you, you know? And tell you that I’m genuinely super duper proud of your development ever since you hit your goal of 10 million subscribers. I don’t know if you hear that genuinely, I don’t know if maybe you think everything is superficial and it’s just “ahh I’m Cory I’m getting glazed ahh” but it’s not that.

You’ve been doing so many good things for so many people. Inspiring other people. Your entire persona on this application, on this plane—it’s so selfless it’s impossible to imagine. You’re giving it your all and it’s showing, your manga is amazing, one aspiring writer to another, and artist to another the art is phenomenal. I remember getting hooked on this shit, like.. “I’ll be your North Star. You’re free man.” The line we got for the first volumes kickstart, it was amazing to me, and so many others. 

I get the feeling of stress, I do. I go through it every day, I wake up all the time always wondering “did I do the right thing?” Or “could I have been better?” I’ve lost so much, this year man. Friends, loves—a life. I thought I’d lost all potential, any meaning I could possibly attain from my life. But then there’s you, fighting through familial problems, personal realizations.. an entire community on your shoulders. You don’t have to do what you do. You could retire and no one could ever hate you, miss you-? Yes, but we’d understand. But you stay. You stay despite how hard it is. 

So don’t doubt yourself—but never ignore that weight. The plate is full, lots of the time. And damn does it hurt, and damn does it suck. But, if there’s anything you showed me? It’s that no matter what we as humans can power through anything. We’re doing our best. We’re always trying and that’s what matters. The least we can ever do is try, and at the same time that’s what counts the most. 

You’re like a symbol, man. But don’t let that define you. At the end of the day you’re just a guy like the rest of us, you don’t need to be invincible, that’s not what anyone is asking you. 

You’re not doing anything wrong, I believe so. You’re doing so many great things (sorry if that’s repetitive). Stress is natural. Just don’t ignore it, man. Don’t let it eat away at you. I think the world of you, one random fan amongst the hundreds of thousands. 

Damn you’ve come far dude. Thats why you’re the goat, THE shogun. 

God bless you and your endeavors, as your samurai I’ll always stay standing.
